value_gb.description: Estimated peak memory requirement in GB.

rationale.description: Evidence from tool output (section sizes, symbol names, strings) that supports this estimate.

value.description: Estimated required vCPU count, or "ALL" if the code is expected to use all available vCPUs.

rationale.description: Evidence from tool output (parallelization libraries, thread symbols, argument hints) that supports this estimate.
Evidence from tool output (CUDA/HIP/OpenCL libraries, GPU symbols, cuobjdump output) that supports this estimate.

value.description: Estimated number of GPUs required. Use 0 if none needed, an integer for a specific count, or "ALL" if the code is expected to use all available GPUs.

rationale.description: Evidence (nccl, multi-GPU init symbols, argument names) that supports this estimate.

value_gb.description: Estimated GPU memory requirement per GPU in GB. Use 0 if no GPU acceleration is needed.

rationale.description: Evidence (kernel register pressure from cuobjdump, model size hints, strings) that supports this estimate.

strategies.description: All parallelization approaches used/required. Use ["none"] if no parallelism is detected.

rationale.description: Evidence (specific library names, init symbols, call graph patterns) that supports this classification.

value.description: True if the workload is primarily I/O bound (large file reads/writes, network I/O) rather than compute-bound.

rationale.description: Evidence (strings output, argument names, library dependencies, vectorization density) that supports this classification.

value.description: CPU architecture required to run this binary. Use "arm64" or "x86_64" for compiled native binaries targeting a specific ISA; use "ANY" for platform-independent executables such as Python scripts, JVM bytecode, or shell scripts.

rationale.description: Evidence (ELF machine type from readelf/file output, ISA-specific instructions, interpreter shebang, or bytecode format) that supports this classification.
